mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury bathroom remodel versus a standard renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury bathroom remodel typically involves high-end materials, custom designs, advanced technology, and bespoke finishes that go beyond functional upgrades. This often includes features like heated floors, smart showers, custom cabinetry, designer fixtures, and premium natural stone. For Hometelligent Inc., a luxury remodel often means a focus on personalized layouts and exclusive material selections, ensuring a unique and sophisticated space tailored to your preferences, rather than just updating existing elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury remodels use high-end materials, custom designs, and advanced technology like heated floors or smart showers, differentiating them from standard renovations.
